description:
The image is a section drawing titled "Diagram 3.12 Floor type 2.1C(a) – floor type 2.1 with ceiling treatment C and floating floor (a)". The word "SECTION" appears in the lower right corner of the framed drawing.

The section shows a stack of horizontal layers running across the width of the frame. At the very top is a thin line, below which three small rectangles each marked with a cross (X) are spaced at the left, centre and right. Beneath them is a layer filled with diagonal hatching. Under this hatched layer is a thick band filled with a speckled, dotted pattern, the thickest element in the drawing. Below this band are three further cross-marked rectangles, again positioned at left, centre and right, roughly in line with those above. A final thin line closes the section at the bottom. No dimensions or numerical labels are shown within the drawing itself.
